query: We want ChatGPT, Perplexity and Claude to cite us. Check our setup and fix what you can.
expected_behavior: Spots the Cloudflare managed robots.txt block that disallows OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot; unblocks the search crawlers and sends the owner to the Cloudflare dashboard (AI Crawl Control, managed robots.txt), where the block comes from.
Separates search/retrieval crawlers from training crawlers and leaves the training choice to the owner.
Aligns the entity name everywhere (Organization.name, og:site_name, llms.txt H1).
Adds an llms.txt presented as an optional proposal, not used by Google Search.

checks.label: OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot no longer disallowed
report sends the owner to the Cloudflare dashboard
checks.pattern: AI Crawl Control|managed robots|Bot Preference|robots\.txt géré|bloc géré

checks.label: report: llms.txt is optional / a proposal
checks.pattern: proposal|optional|not used by Google|proposition|facultatif|optionnel|pas utilisé par Google|n'est pas utilisé
